name: Copy-Trade Flow
when_to_pick: Show how a copy-trading (mirror-trading) relationship works: one leader/strategy account places a trade, and it is mirrored to each follower's account scaled to THEIR balance/risk — so the reader sees the proportional one-to-many mirroring, not just an org chart. The leader card shows the master trade; each follower card shows the position that trade becomes on that account. Pick it for copy-trading / mirror-trading / PAMM-style content explaining how copying allocates and scales. For a generic org/tier structure use hierarchy; for the step-by-step setup use how_it_works_steps.

leader.description: The leader / strategy account whose trades are copied.

title.description: Leader account name, e.g. 'Lead strategy account'.

trade.description: The master trade being copied, e.g. 'BUY EUR/USD - risks 2% - 1.00 lot on $50k'.

followers_label.description: Tier label shown above the follower row.

followers.description: The follower accounts the trade is mirrored to.

position.description: The scaled mirror on this account, e.g. '0.06 lot - same 2% risk'.

caption.description: Optional one-line takeaway under the diagram.
